launchMarkets: Worldwide, subject to applicable law and store/provider availability
retentionDetails: Active user records remain until deletion. Paid Gemini's standard abuse monitoring retains prompts, context and responses for 55 days. The current Vercel Hobby plan provides one hour of runtime-log retention; its team has no configured log drains. This is not a complete security-log or backup deletion guarantee. Supabase's internal log/backup exceptions, any manual exports, and legally required payment-record retention must be confirmed before final publication.
